rounds.title: Select controls
rounds.note: Declares the select's controls so design complete can check it: field hover, press and focus, the open panel, option hover, selected and keyboard-active options. The variants differ only in the trigger's pressed look, which the SDK does not have yet.

rounds.title: Final select
rounds.note: b with the control frame as a data-et-control-part; waits on that CLI marker

a.note: No pressed look: pressing the field looks like hover. Costs nothing, needs an approved design complete exception for active.

b.note: The field border darkens one step while pressed. A small CSS rule in the text shell; reads like a button press.

c.note: The focus colour shows on the field border at once on press, before focus lands. A small CSS rule; previews the focus look the press leads to.
